nav.offRouteHint: Ski back to the blue line, or re-route.

link.intro: Draw a skiable link the map is missing. Pick both ends from the list, or pin them anywhere on the map (even mid-slope) - pinned points become custom junctions.

routeTypeHelp.balanced: One best route for each goal - fastest, fewest lifts, and so on.
routeTypeHelp.fewest_lifts: 3 options that ride the fewest lifts.
routeTypeHelp.preferred: 3 options that stay on your preferred colours.
routeTypeHelp.longest: The 3 longest lift-free runs to your destination.

prefs.speedHelpBody: We estimate your real speed on each run colour, then add the extra distance your turns create - steeper runs mean more turns - so times reflect real skiing, not a straight line. Your "skiing speed" above tunes it (better skiers keep more speed on steep runs).

route.liftDownhill: This route rides a lift downhill
route.inferredWarning: Uses an app-added bridge (dotted magenta) - verify it's actually skiable
route.usesCustom: Uses one of your custom links (dotted cyan)

longest.intro: The longest possible descents without taking a lift (top to bottom), for your level.
longest.inferredWarning: Uses an app-added bridge (dotted magenta) - verify it's actually skiable

closed.intro: Statuses are assumed open. Mark a run or lift closed (⊘ on a route step) and routes will avoid it.

speeds.title: My measured speeds
speeds.intro: Your real GPS speed vs our estimate of it (both are real move speeds). The extra distance you cover carving side to side is handled separately, so the two are compared on the same basis. Apply to use your measured speeds for ETAs.
speeds.unlockHint_one: Ski at least {{count}} second on a colour while navigating to unlock it.
speeds.unlockHint_other: Ski at least {{count}} seconds on a colour while navigating to unlock it.

notice.followingOn: Showing your location - following you. Tap the button again to stop.
notice.followingRecentered: Recentered - following you again. Tap the button again to stop.
notice.navNoRoute: Find and pick a route first, then start navigation.
notice.speedsNotEnough: Not enough measured data yet - ski a bit on each colour while navigating.
notice.speedsOn: Using your measured speeds. Turn off in preferences to go back to the model.
notice.geoUnavailable: Geolocation is not available in this browser.
notice.geoFailedPick: Could not get your location. Pick a point or pin on the map instead.
notice.pickBoth: Pick both a start and a destination first.
notice.shareCopied: Message + link copied to clipboard - send it to a friend.
notice.geoFailedShare: Could not get your location to share.
notice.sharePlaceFailed: Could not place the shared location on this resort.
notice.geoUnavailableFrom: Geolocation is not available - pick a start point (From), then Find routes.
notice.geoPlaceFailedFrom: Could not place your location on this resort - pick a start point (From).
notice.geoFailedFrom: Could not get your location - pick a start point (From), then Find routes.
notice.linkPickBoth: Pick both a "Link from" and a "Link to" point for the link.
notice.linkPickDistinct: Pick two different points for the link.
notice.longestNone: No lift-free run found for your level. Try raising your max difficulty.
notice.closureLocateFailed: Could not locate this closure on the map.
notice.shareNoDest: Pick a destination (To) first, then share it.
notice.navNoRouteHere: No route from your current position.
notice.linkAdded: Added a {{color}} link ({{direction}}). Press "Find routes" to use it.
notice.longestDestSet: Destination set to the start of the longest run ({{name}}). Pick your start point A (or tap "My location"), then press Find routes.
notice.closedMarked: Marked "{{label}}" closed - routes will avoid it. Reopen it in the "Closed today" panel.

app.globalHint: Zoomed out - click a resort flag (or pick one from the list) to open it
app.pinHintPoint: Click the map to set the {{which}} point
app.pinHintLink: Click the map to place the link's {{which}} point (anywhere)

statusNotice.title: Lift & slope status
statusNotice.text: Shown as OPEN by default - in early or late season some lifts and runs may actually be closed.
statusNotice.tip: Tip: mark a closed lift or run (⊘ on a route step) and Find Route will avoid it.

routes.title: Route options
routes.noLiftFree: No lift-free route to this point at your level.
routes.tapToSet: (tap to set as destination, then Find routes).
routes.tryLower: Try a lower difficulty or a different destination.

share.msgHere: 📍 Meet me at {{place}} - open this SkiWaze link to navigate there:
share.msgMe: 📍 Come meet me on the slopes! Open this SkiWaze link and it'll route you to my location:

sharePrompt.text: A location was shared with you - set as your destination. Navigate there?

notes.missingHours: Some lifts have no opening-hours data - closing-time warnings may be missing.
notes.defaultWait: Default lift wait times were used (no measured data).
notes.defaultSpeed: Default ski speeds were used for some runs (unknown difficulty).

warn.customEdge: This route uses one of your custom links (dotted cyan on the map).
warn.syntheticEdge: This route uses an app-added bridge across a mapped gap (dotted magenta) that may not be exactly skiable.
warn.offPiste: This section is off-piste (freeride): unmarked, ungroomed and unpatrolled.
warn.offPisteNamed: {{name}} is off-piste (freeride): unmarked, ungroomed and unpatrolled.
warn.color: Run is {{color}}, outside your preferred colors.
warn.defaultSpeed: Using a default ski speed (piste color unknown).
warn.hours: Opening hours unknown for this lift.
warn.hoursAll: Opening hours are unknown for every lift on this route.
warn.defaultWait: Using a default wait time for this lift.
warn.defaultWaitNamed: Using a default wait time for {{name}}.

error.noneClosures: No route found - some lifts/runs on the way are marked closed. Try reopening one, or relax difficulty / lift types.
error.nonePrefs: No route found with your current preferences (try relaxing difficulty, lift types, or turning off "Avoid app-added bridges").
